verdict.rationale: Fathom documents meeting capture and recording: unlimited recordings and transcriptions, a choice of bot-free (beta) or bot capture, a custom meeting bot, and an API endpoint to download recordings. However, nothing in the evidence names Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams, and nothing speaks to capture reliability. missing for 10: explicit Zoom/Google Meet/Microsoft Teams platform coverage, evidence of capture reliability, controls over which meetings get recorded or where recordings are stored, independent or hands-on corroboration.
